name: Claude apps
summary: Anthropic's Claude assistant on the web (claude.ai), desktop and mobile, including Cowork tasks in the desktop app, which takes Agent Skills, MCP connectors and plugins.

skills.what: Skills (a folder with a SKILL.md) can be uploaded and used on Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise plans, with code execution turned on.

mcp.what: Custom connectors using remote MCP work on all plans (Free is limited to one) and connect from Anthropic's cloud; local MCP servers run only in Claude Desktop and in Cowork sessions on your computer, not in claude.ai chat.

sources.title: Get started with custom connectors using remote MCP

plugins.what: Plugins bundling skills, commands, connectors and agents are added from Customize > Plugins (directory, a Git marketplace, or an uploaded folder with .claude-plugin/plugin.json) on paid plans; chat loads only skills, commands and connectors, Cowork also loads agents and hooks.

hooks.what: A plugin's hooks (hooks/hooks.json) load in Cowork in the desktop app and are ignored in chat on the web, desktop and mobile.

scheduled-work.what: Scheduled tasks in Cowork run a saved prompt on a chosen cadence as their own sessions, remotely even while the computer is asleep, on all paid plans.

sources.title: Schedule recurring tasks in Claude Cowork

sandboxes.what: Code execution and file creation runs code in an isolated, sandboxed container on all plans, with network access set by plan and admin settings.

sources.title: Create and edit files with Claude
